items.hook: The Test of Word Reading Efficiency, commonly abbreviated as TOWRE–2 for its second edition, is a kind of reading test developed to test the efficiency of reading ability of children from age 6–24 years.
items.body: It generally seeks to measure an individual's accuracy and fluency regarding two efficiencies; Sight Word Efficiency (SWE) and Phonemic Decoding Efficiency (PDE). The world is stranger than it lets on.
